description: Search Swop user identities (swop.ids) by handle or display name. Returns handle, display name, avatar, and public EVM/Solana wallet addresses. Use this to find a user or resolve a name to a wallet address.

query.description: Handle or name fragment, at least 2 characters (e.g. "travis")

name: swop_search_identities
title: Search swop.id identities
